BiblicalUsage: Kara means to grieve — here, the grief that seizes the spirit. Daniel says, I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that visions can grieve as well as gladden: Daniel was troubled by what he saw, and the grief itself was part of hearing God.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
